note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md (2026-11-26). Wide pictures only (1920x1088). Each scene starts at the first word of its verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper 60% of the frame, clear of the word box. God is not pictured; Abram, Sarai, Lot and the others are only ordinary people of today, seen from behind or small. Fixed recurring objects: Abram's tent is a small plain weathered tan canvas tent on a simple wooden pole frame; the altar is a small altar of stacked rough fieldstones; the oak is one huge old oak with a broad gnarled trunk and a wide dark-green crown.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning; (2) write picture ideas for each; (3) judge them; (4) make the top two for each slot as real pictures and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: Abram comes back up from Egypt, rich in everything, to the first tent place and the first altar at Bethel.
Abram and Lot cannot share the land; Abram lets Lot choose, and Lot takes the well-watered plain and moves toward evil Sodom.
Yahweh tells Abram to look in every direction: all the land is his offspring's, as countless as dust; Abram settles at Mamre and builds an altar.
